findings.issue: S6 frames the approach as challenging reliance on gradient descent and specialized hardware. 'Report that the approach avoids reliance' hardens that positioning into a reported hardware-independence result. S3 explicitly establishes the gradient-descent-free design, but the abstract gives no comparable hardware demonstration. The rest of the card retains the hardware uncertainty and correctly describes the core method, so this is a local attribution precision issue.
findings.correction: Preserve the authors' positioning language rather than asserting established hardware independence.

summary.scope: Read all six original source-unit sets and all extraction fields in runs/audit-source-review-iclr-2026/packet-01.json. Checked entailment, attribution, numerical scope, qualifiers, locators, narrative, unknowns, and separation of lesson observations from interpretation and proposed application. BioX-Bridge preserves the trainable-parameter denominator and 88-99% reduction; Frozen-PINN preserves nine benchmarks and often several orders of magnitude; AgentGym-RL preserves the 27-task comparison and named systems; the monitoring card retains 15% TPR improvement at FPR 0.01 without inventing a percentage-point interpretation. No material error found; one local attribution issue and two incomplete locator sets require minor correction.
summary.limitations: AI source checking only. This review does not independently verify experiments, proofs, novelty, reproducibility, or lesson effectiveness. Initial random-audit outcomes are preserved; no cards were edited, no model calls were made, and no corpus-wide accuracy or gate decision is issued.
